text:
alex: Quick heads-up — spotted 3 broken internal links in /runbooks/serving/runtime.md while following the troubleshooting flow. They all look like bad anchors after the last TOC rename. Leaving details below.

alex: Paths found: /runbooks/serving/runtime.md#kv-cache, #batching, #fallback-routing -> 404 within KB viewer.

maya: thanks for flagging, can you paste the offending anchors or a grep so I can grab them in a sweep? :eyes:

alex: sure — ripgrep across repo matched these: 
`rg "runtime.md#(kv-cache|batching|fallback-routing)" -n docs/`
Also one rendered link in the runbook itself points to `../platform/deployments.md#canary` which should be `../platform/deployments.md#canary-rollouts` (TOC changed last week).

sam: I can take the runbook edits today. Quick question — do we want to keep the short anchor names or migrate to the full hyphenated ones? I'm fine aligning to current TOC in platform docs.

lina: align to current TOC (hyphenated). Also update the in-repo link targets and add a short redirect in the frontmatter so older permalinks don't 404 for customers. Example frontmatter snippet: `redirect_from: ["/runbooks/serving#kv-cache"]`

sam: sg — I'll open a tiny PR with the fixes + a note in the runbook changelog. PR link when ready.

alex: thanks. one more small ask — can you also run the linkcheck job locally before pushing? `make linkcheck` should catch these.

sam: yep running it now. if CI is green I'll mark for quick review.

deploy-bot: CI passed — docs/linkcheck (ubuntu-latest) ✔ — 3 warnings fixed.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — includes anchor updates, frontmatter redirects, and a one-line changelog. pinging @maya for a quick review when you have a sec.

maya: reviewing now. small nits: one relative path can be simplified and one codeblock fenced language. will approve after tiny cleanups.

sam: pushed fixes, PTAL.

maya: approved :thumbsup: — merging once deploy-bot shows green deploy check.

deploy-bot: Merge complete. Site deploy started. Preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/412 — looks good on staging.

alex: amazing, thanks everyone. leaving this thread in case anyone else runs into similar anchor drift in other runbooks.

sam: noted — I'll add a short note to the docs-owner checklist to run a TOC sanity check when renaming headings.
